yt_title: Top 5 Science Experiments You Can Do At Home #Shorts
desc: Top 5 science experiments you can do at home with kitchen items: floating needle, milk colour burst, mini volcano, walking water and a diving ketchup packet. Each one shows a real physics or chemistry idea. New fizzy fact every day on Fruit Soda.
caption: Five safe experiments, zero fancy gear 🧪 Which one are you trying first? Comment 1 to 5. Ask an adult to help with the kitchen bits. Follow for a fact every day.

lines.text: Top five science experiments you can do tonight with kitchen stuff.
One. A steel needle floats on water because of surface tension.
Two. A drop of dish soap makes food colour in milk burst outward.
Three. Baking soda and vinegar make fizzing carbon dioxide gas.
Four. A paper towel makes water climb from one cup to another.
Five. A ketchup packet in a bottle dives when you squeeze. It is the strangest one.
